definitions.fieldDomain: Q-isomorphism classes of degree-2 extensions K/Q with no real embedding
definitions.countingFunction: N_5,2^-(X) counts fields in fieldDomain with |Disc(K)| <= X and rank5 >= 2
definitions.landauLowerBound: f(X) >> g(X) means there exist c > 0 and X_0 > 1 such that for every real X >= X_0, f(X) >= c*g(X)
definitions.noncyclic5ClassGroup: the Sylow-5 subgroup of Cl(K) is noncyclic; for finite Cl(K), this is equivalent to rank5 >= 2 and to containing (Z/5Z)^2

statements.formalStatement: There exists delta in Q_{>0} such that for every epsilon in R_{>0} there exist c_epsilon in R_{>0} and X_epsilon > 1 such that every real X >= X_epsilon satisfies N_5,2^-(X) >= c_epsilon X^(1/3+delta-epsilon).
statements.normalized: EXISTS delta IN Q_{>0} SUCH THAT FOR ALL epsilon IN R_{>0} THERE EXIST c_epsilon IN R_{>0} AND X_epsilon IN R_{>1} SUCH THAT FOR ALL X IN R WITH X >= X_epsilon, N_5,2^-(X) >= c_epsilon * X^(1/3 + delta - epsilon), WHERE N_5,2^-(X) IS THE NUMBER OF Q-ISOMORPHISM CLASSES OF FIELDS K WITH [K:Q] = 2, K HAS NO REAL EMBEDDING, |Disc(K)| <= X, AND dim_F5(Cl(K)/5Cl(K)) >= 2.

alignment.condition: Interpret X^(1/3+delta-o(1)) as an arbitrary fixed epsilon loss in the exponent, allow lower-bound constants and thresholds to depend on epsilon, and interpret explicit delta as an exhibited fixed positive rational.
